Package io.webagent4j.extraction.api

Interface IValueConverter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the converted value's type
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface IValueConverter<T>
Deterministically converts one raw extracted string to a target type.

Conversion is always explicit and deterministic - never a probabilistic or "best effort" guess. An input that does not cleanly convert raises ExtractionConversionException rather than silently substituting a default or a partial parse.
